versions.content: When development error detection is enabled for the module: The function Wdg_SetTriggerCondition shall check that the timeout parameter given is less or equal to the maximum timeout value ( WdgMaxTimeout ). If this is not the case the function shall not reload the timeout counter but raise the development error WDG_E_PARAM_TIMEOUT and return to the caller.
